_readme: Structures lane: biome × entries × sizes[] × seeds. Tall/wide canvases use flux pixel limits (1536×1024 / 1024×1536). Filenames include WxH.
prompt_template: isometric 2.5D fantasy strategy map object sprite, single centered prop {subject}, Heroes of Might and Magic III inspired hand-painted readability, subtle orthographic tilt for depth, isolated object, white neutral backdrop for alpha extraction, no terrain floor plane beyond minimal prop shadow suggestion, biome palette cues only as accent not backdrop scenery: {biome_hint}
negative_prompt: blurry, soft focus, oversharpen, noisy texture, seamless terrain tile panorama, aerial satellite, grass carpet ground, person, human, character, face, dragon, mounted unit, army, watermark, logo, text, duplicate buildings, city skyline
